notes.title: GRAPPIN now available on PS5!
notes.content:
[p]Hi there,

Big news for GRAPPIN today!

I'm glad to announce that [b]GRAPPIN is now available on PS5[/b]!

The climb is the same, but the feeling is brand new. On PS5, haptic feedback and sounds from the controller speaker will let you feel every grapple and impact. [/p][p]
Motion controls have also been added, you can just aim by tilting the DualSense controller. 
Oh, and if you’re playing on Steam Deck, motion controls are supported there too. It really adds a nice touch to the experience.

Check out the new trailer here: [/p][previewyoutube="aHM6Jd4gNUc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]GRAPPIN on PlayStation Store:  [/p][p][url="https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012872"]https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012872[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p]Also, GRAPPIN is also available on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S: [url="https://www.xbox.com/games/store/grappin/9nvggr800d81"]https://www.xbox.com/games/store/grappin/9nvggr800d81[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Please feel free to join GRAPPIN Discord server! [url="https://discord.gg/8y5a3bcadf"]https://discord.gg/8y5a3bcadf[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and see you up there! [/p][p]POLYLABO[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41019476/f3940b1ec7d52a3b91564da502459132df51b411.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Happy Birthday, GRAPPIN!
notes.content:
Hi there,

One year has passed since GRAPPIN's release! How time flies!
Releasing this game already feels nostalgic... 

We are doing a few things to properly celebrate GRAPPIN's birthday!

[h3]Anniversary Sale [/h3]
Spring Sale is extended and GRAPPIN is still [b]45% off until March 28![/b]

[h3]New Illustration [/h3]
[url=https://twitter.com/JamesTurner_42]James Turner[/url], who created the GRAPPIN main key-art, also made a new art for the game. Look at him go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41019476/f7adde149589cc6e3c3700cd3c3824151a872bff.jpg[/img]

[h3]Wallpapers [/h3]
A gift for you!
Here is a new pack containing wallpapers for your computer or your smartphone. Including art from the legendary Takaya Imamura and James Turner!
[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ea4L_uKM4OPiqdlWn_HxKEBOnUjWR6lt/view?usp=drive_link]GRAPPIN Wallpaper Pack Download[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41019476/1385710a19b06bfb0f7593655e619771ce3d256b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Update 1.1.0 + introducing POLYLABO [/h3]
Also, I'm happy to announce that I created my very own (micro) game studio based in Japan, Tokyo: [b]POLYLABO[/b]. POLYLABO is the new home for GRAPPIN and hopefully new games coming in the future. 

Website: polylabo.co

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41019476/b1e11d7ebf199bb2cce8e5bd9e314c379fe9692e.jpg[/img]

A new update has been released to reflect this new change. (1.1.0)

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for your support.
Your feedback made the game better and it's not over yet!

Also, there should be some cool surprises this year... Stay tuned!

Heartfelt thanks to all the climbers who dared to take on the challenge!
And again, [b]happy birthday GRAPPIN![/b]

Ahmin

notes.title: GRAPPIN Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]GRAPPIN is now available on Steam![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41019476/2b8dbdd05c11ae6449c2eb1c0eec9e8e532b03c0.jpg[/img]

The game I have been working on for a very long time in my spare time has finally been released. 
It feels unreal and it's hard to put my thoughts into words.

This has been a long road finishing this game but I’m happy that GRAPPIN is now available to all. 

GRAPPIN is priced at [b]12.99$[/b] (12.79€, 1500¥) and GRAPPIN Original Soundtrack is priced at [b]3.99$[/b]. (3.99€, 470¥) There is a [b]15% discount[/b] on the first week. 

There is also the [b]GRAPPIN Deluxe Edition[/b], which regroups both the full game and the original soundtrack at a reduced price. (15% discount)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41019476/dd0b2abd763ea4e120887966557d4b24537dfec0.jpg[/img]

Also, yet to be verified by Valve but GRAPPIN is fully compatible with Steam Deck.

[b]Launch trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=L5nEvPPZI2Y;full][/previewyoutube]
I do hope that you will enjoy your journey to the summit! 
Please feel free let me know your feedback and thoughts about the game.

Oh and we do have a Discord server! 
https://discord.gg/8y5a3bcadf
Feel free to join on the fun!

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for the continued support, feedback and kindness.
Me and Benoit have poured our hearts into the making of this game and we hope that you will enjoy your journey to the top of the mountain. 

Enough talk, now go on sharping your grapple hook, put on your polar coat and scarf! 

[b]Adventure awaits![/b]

Ahmin

notes.title: GRAPPIN News #6 - Summer news!
notes.content:
Hi there!

Lots of things happened this summer. 

First of all, thanks to everyone who played the demo so far! Steam Next Fest was an hectic experience and got many feedbacks that I'm using to finish up the development. 

A lot of things have been happening in the background since the Steam Next Fest has ended.

So! Just a quick digest:

[b]・Asobu Indie Connect 2022 (Tokyo)[/b]
GRAPPIN was featured during the Asobu Indie Connect 2022!
Featuring new (hot!) gameplay footage! It is an honor to be part of this show and many thanks to asobu crew for making this happening.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PPLr9OK5GG4&t=4670

[b]・BitSummit X-Roads (Kyoto)[/b]
GRAPPIN was showcased there and as usual, it was an hectic experience!

[b]・gamescom 2022 (Cologne)[/b]
GRAPPIN will be showcased at gamescom 2022 (from today!) as part of the Japan Pavilion, courtesy of Indie Live Expo!
This is the first time the game will be showcased in Europe and I'm so excited for this!

[b]・Busan Indie Connect 2022  (South Korea)[/b]
GRAPPIN has been selected to BIC 2022 and will be playable! If you're in Busan, come say hi!

[b]・New key-art![/b]
Takaya Imamura created a new illustration for GRAPPIN.
We wanted the new illustration to emphasize the grapple hook action!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FaH-K2iaQAABSgM?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

[b]・Next?[/b]
I'm still busy finishing up the game and I hope to announce something concerning the release date soon!

Again, thank you for sticking around and your feedbacks, it means a lot. 

See you very soon!
Ahmin

notes.title: GRAPPIN News #5 - The demo is now available!
notes.content:
Hi there!  

It's been a while!  

I'm glad to announce that GRAPPIN is part of the Steam Next Fest!  

[b]A demo is now available for all to play! [/b] 

The demo features the Valley of Trials, a luxurious place full of green. The Valley of Trials serves as a starting point in your adventure and where you will have to prove yourself worthy of the Grip.   

This is just a taste of what's to come in the full version of the game, coming later this year. After all of the work in my spare time, releasing a demo feels unreal and I'm happy to be able to finally share it. Hoping to read many feedbacks in the coming days! I also hope that you will like what you hear, Benoit brought a lot of life in this world!   

By the way, there is a GRAPPIN's official Discord server! Feel free to join the fun and share feedbacks, discoveries and bugs (I hope not for the latter) or just chat!  

[b]Discord server link: [/b]
https://discord.gg/8y5a3bcadf

Thank you for the support and hanging around. 

I hope you will enjoy the demo!  

Ahmin

In the meantime, the communication has started around the game and I created a new Twitter account:

Feel free to follow this account to get the latest news and developments around GRAPPIN!

To celebrate this, Takaya Imamura (former Nintendo Art Director on The Legend of Zelda series, StarFox series and F-ZERO series) unveiled the official character's artwork for GRAPPIN's main character! 

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FLDvpehaAAE3__X?format=jpg&name=900x900[/img]

GRAPPIN will be released this year and I hope to have more stuff to show soon!

Until then, please stay safe!
Ahmin

notes.title: GRAPPIN News #2 - Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have been working on GRAPPIN alone in my spare time, with Benoit who is in charge of the soundtrack and sound design.

We were aiming to release the game this year but after a playtest session (which went well!), we figured that a lot of fixes are needed if we were to put GRAPPIN to the quality level we are seeking for.

[b]GRAPPIN will be released somewhere in early 2022. [/b] 

We're not far from the final game but we need to put more work in the polish and bug fixing. Game development is tough, making a game on your own is even tougher and making on your own AND in your spare time is definitely something else...

Nevertheless, I hope that you're looking forward to GRAPPIN!
